concerns.text: The plan states (in the Technical Context and in FR‑008) that a Bonferroni correction will be applied to the three pairwise predictor correlations, but the research specification (research.md) requires a False Discovery Rate (FDR) correction using the Benjamini‑Hochberg procedure. This inconsistency means the statistical validation does not match the declared requirement and could mislead reviewers about the stringency of multiple‑testing control.
